mapper.sql: EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_translations dtr WHERE dtr.destination_id = d.id AND dtr.language_code = #{languageCode} AND dtr.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )

FROM destinations d JOIN destination_translations dt ON dt.destination_id = d.id AND dt.language_code = 'ko' LEFT JOIN country_categories cc ON cc.id = d.region_id LEFT JOIN country_categories pcc ON pcc.id = cc.parent_id

WHERE ( dt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR dt.short_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR dt.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR cc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR pcc.region_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_categories dcat JOIN categories cat ON cat.id = dcat.category_id WHERE dcat.destination_id = d.id AND cat.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_translations dtr WHERE dtr.destination_id = d.id AND dtr.language_code = #{languageCode} AND ( dtr.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR dtr.short_description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' ) )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM country_category_translations cctr WHERE cctr.country_category_id IN (cc.id, pcc.id) AND cctr.language_code = #{languageCode} AND cctr.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM destination_categories dcat JOIN category_translations ctr ON ctr.category_id = dcat.category_id WHERE dcat.destination_id = d.id AND ctr.language_code = #{languageCode} AND ctr.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
)
FROM user_posts p

WHERE p.post_type IN ('QUESTION', 'TIP') AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR p.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
FROM courses c

WHERE c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
FROM travel_info ti JOIN info_categories ic ON ic.id = ti.category_id AND ic.is_visible = 1
WHERE ( ti.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR ti.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
FROM events e
WHERE ( e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR e.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )
FROM notices n
WHERE ( n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' OR n.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' )

SELECT 'destination' AS search_type, d.id, dt.name AS title, d.created_at, CONCAT('/destinations/', d.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN dt.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!'
OR
THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance

SELECT 'community' AS search_type, p.id, p.title, p.created_at, CONCAT('/post/', p.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance

SELECT 'course' AS search_type, c.id, c.title, c.created_at, CONCAT('/courses/', c.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN c.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance

SELECT 'travel-info' AS search_type, ti.id, ti.title, ti.created_at, CONCAT('/travel-info/', ti.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN ti.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance

SELECT 'event' AS search_type, e.id, e.title, e.created_at, CONCAT('/events/', e.id) AS detail_url, e.start_date, e.end_date, CASE WHEN e.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance

SELECT 'notice' AS search_type, n.id, n.title, n.created_at, CONCAT('/support/notices/', n.id) AS detail_url, NULL AS start_date, NULL AS end_date, CASE WHEN n.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keywordPattern}, '%') ESCAPE '!' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS relevance
